insert into public.import_jobs
  (user_id, file_name, status, progress, status_message, account_id, payment_date)
values
  ($1::uuid, $2, 'pending', 0, 'Recebido pelo WhatsApp. Iniciando processamento...',
   nullif($3, '')::uuid, nullif($4, '')::date)
returning id as job_id;
